title: Circuit mechanisms of psychotic symptoms across disorders
title_zh: 跨疾病精神病症状的电路机制
abstract: Psychotic symptoms, including hallucinations, delusions, and disorganized thought, occur across psychiatric and neurological disorders, yet their underlying mechanisms remain poorly integrated across scales. Here, we propose a transdiagnostic framework in which disturbances in dopamine, glutamate, GABA, serotonin, and acetylcholine alter neuronal gain and synaptic efficacy, disrupting the precision weighting of sensory evidence, prediction errors, and internally generated representations. These local disturbances propagate through cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical circuits and large-scale functional networks, producing abnormal integration-segregation dynamics and unstable attractor states. This multilevel model links molecular and cellular perturbations to circuit dysfunction, network instability, and symptom expression while allowing distinct biological pathways to converge on shared computational vulnerabilities. Emerging neuroimaging, dynamical systems, and artificial intelligence approaches may enable individualized tests of these mechanisms and support more precise, circuit-informed interventions for psychotic symptoms.
abstract_zh: 精神病症状，包括幻觉、妄想和思维紊乱，出现在多种精神和神经疾病中，但其潜在机制在不同尺度上尚未得到充分整合。本文提出一种跨诊断框架，认为多巴胺、谷氨酸、GABA、血清素和乙酰胆碱的失调会改变神经元增益和突触效能，破坏对感官证据、预测误差和内部生成表征的精度加权。这些局部失调通过皮质-纹状体-丘脑-皮质回路和大规模功能网络传播，导致异常的整合-分离动力学和不稳定的吸引子状态。该多层模型将分子和细胞层面的扰动与电路功能障碍、网络不稳定和症状表现联系起来，同时允许不同的生物通路汇聚到共享的计算脆弱性。新兴的神经影像学、动力系统和人工智能方法可能使这些机制的个体化检测成为可能，并支持更精准、基于电路的精神病症状干预。
